BiblicalUsage: Gamal is the camel, the ship of the desert that carries kings and queens. The Queen of Sheba came to Jerusalem with camels that bore spices and gold in 1 Kings 10:2, and the same visit is told again in 2 Chronicles 9:1. Obil the Ishmaelite was over the camels in David's household in 1 Chronicles 27:30, and Saul was told to smite Amalek and spare not camel or ass in 1 Samuel 15:3.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the camel carries the wealth of the world to the feet of wisdom. Sheba's camels bore spices to Solomon, and I hold that the riches of the nations still come to the King who is greater than Solomon.
